merge_system.description: Intelligent merging handles all item data scenarios
process: 1. User clicks merge button on incomplete item
2. Modal opens with search to find matching item
3. User can search by name or ID to find pair
4. System merges data with target-priority logic
5. Handles UNIQUE constraints by deleting conflicts first
6. Updates UI immediately after successful merge

hue_management.description: Complete hue system with individual and bulk operations
individual_hues: Search-based input filters from database hues
bulk_hues: Hue sets for common collections (crafting, ore, etc.)
Bulk addition to items from sets or custom input

script_integration.description: Shows which scripts use each item
process: 1. Displays paginated list of script examples
2. Shows usage context and line numbers
4. Unique React keys prevent rendering errors

backend: routes/items.py - Complete API with all endpoints
models.py - Pydantic models for all operations
frontend: hooks/items/ - Custom hooks for data management

database_locks.problem: SQLite database locks during merge operations
database_locks.solution: Proper connection management with try/except/finally blocks and conn.rollback()

unique_constraints.problem: UNIQUE constraint violations on item_script_usage table
unique_constraints.solution: Delete conflicting records before transferring script usage data

react_keys.problem: Multiple keys error in script examples display
react_keys.solution: Generate unique IDs combining script_id and line_number

numeric_names.problem: Items with numeric names not properly handled
numeric_names.solution: Automatic detection and conversion to item_id field

hue_editing_ui.problem: No proper UI for editing hue descriptions
hue_editing_ui.solution: Created EditHueModal with proper form validation and feedback

search_functionality.problem: Case-sensitive search made finding items difficult
search_functionality.solution: Made search case-insensitive for both names and IDs

manual_testing: All merge scenarios (name+ID, duplicate items, numeric names)
Hue management (individual editing, bulk operations, hue sets)

key_patterns_established.search_ux: Case-insensitive search for better user experience
